ai_summary: **Executive Summary:**  Aqylon Nexus Limited has announced a comprehensive overhaul of key leadership and audit functions, including the appointment of a new Executive (Non-Independent) Director, Chief Financial Officer, Internal Auditor, and a replacement Secretarial Auditor, all effective August 4, 2026. While these appointments suggest an intent to strengthen governance, potential red flags include the relatively limited professional experience of the new CFO (four years) and the very recently established Secretarial Auditor firm (practicing since February 2026), particularly given the unexplained, same-day resignation of the previous Secretarial Auditor due to "inability to continue." These factors warrant further scrutiny into the depth of experience now overseeing critical financial and compliance activities.
